messages.subject: ode integrator time ordered
parts:
Dear all,

I'm using the ode_integrator which work very well. thank you.

just one think, for some of my data, I have several measures at the same time, hence the following error message:

"times is not a valid ordered vector. The element at 2 is 1, but should be greater than the previous element, 1"

I understand this is not possible but how can we deal with such things ?

I thought about 2 things:
1 - I could provide a kind of "mean" using transformed data and then having one for a single time.
2 - I could "trick" the ode_integrator by transforming data at the same time to an ordered sequence: for instance, if I've 3 data at time 1, I can spread them around 1: 0.999, 1.000, 1.001.

What is the best way ?

messages.author: a5e83218c834e013
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] ode integrator time ordered
parts:
Just use the given solution multiple times,

y <- integrate_ode(…);
y_hat ~ normal(y, sigma); // vectorized statement for each time point
y_hat_extra_1 ~ normal(y[duplicate_time_1], sigma); // additional data at t = ts[duplicate_time_1]
y_hat_extra_2 ~ normal(y[duplicate_time_2], sigma); // additional data at t = ts[duplicate_time_2]
